template.title: Report a product issue
template.description: About 1–2 minutes, no sign-in required. Report one issue at a time and describe what you saw. Do not share passwords or API keys, and hide private details in screenshots.
template.thanks: Thank you for your feedback! We will review it and prioritize issues that affect usability.
template.details: What were you doing, and what went wrong?
template.detailsHint: For example: I clicked Save, but it kept loading for two minutes. Include any error message and the approximate date and time if you remember.
template.device: Which device and browser were you using?
template.deviceHint: For example: iPhone Safari, Android Chrome, desktop Edge or an in-app browser. “Not sure” is fine.
template.cluesHint: Include the feature name, page URL or anything you have tried. Share whatever you know.
template.attachmentHint: Only upload relevant files. Hide any private information.
template.contact: May we contact you for more details?
template.contactHint: Optionally leave Discord, QQ or an email address. For account or saving issues, you may also include your username in the product.
